messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: HIGH: Serving errors spike in northamerica-west1 zone-b — 5xx rate ~18% for text-generate-prod across GPUs. Paging oncall maya.
maya: on it. seeing increased 5xx from worker pool wg-wnw-02. tailing logs now.
kevin: jump in. any host-level OOMs? I can start looking at GPU metrics.
maya: no OOMs in dmesg. errors look like grpc status 14 downstream timeouts to model server. snippet:

```
2026-03-15T14:08:12Z worker-07 grpc: rpc error: code = Unavailable desc = connection closed
2026-03-15T14:08:13Z worker-10 model: kvcache miss flush error: transport reset
```
kevin: ok, could be a network flapping to zone-b edge. I'm seeing packet drops on nic eth1 in host pool 3.
taylor: putting initial mitigation: shifting traffic off zone-b to zone-a and zone-c for affected model routes. Updating routing policy now to prefer northamerica-west1-zone-a then fallthrough.
jess: make sure to keep one small shard in zone-b for health checks so we can continue probing. Also enable conservative retry on gateway for 60s to avoid client-side errors.
maya: applied temporary routing override:

```
# override to shift routing for text-generate-prod
redwood route update text-generate-prod --prefer zones=northamerica-west1-zone-a,northamerica-west1-zone-c --drain=zone-b --dry-run=false
```
incident-bot: Routing override applied by maya. Requests now showing 95% shift to zone-a within 20s. 5xx rate trending down to ~3%.
olivia: heads-up — customers on enterprise plans in NA may notice degraded responses; prepping a status page draft and customer DM. will share shortly.
kevin: network team reporting flapping on a top-of-rack switch for zone-b rack-11. They're replacing the ASIC fabric. ETA 45m.
jess: thanks. continue to monitor KV cache warmup in zone-a — we may see transient latency while shards warm.
status-bot: Proposed status page update (draft):

```
Title: Degraded service in northamerica-west1 (zone-b)
Current status: Partial degradation — Mitigation in progress
Affected services: text generation, chat (some requests returned 5xx)
Regions impacted: northamerica-west1 (zone-b)
Start time: 2026-03-15T14:08:12Z
Customer impact: Some customers experienced increased errors and higher latency. We have shifted traffic away from the affected zone to reduce impact.
Next update: 30 minutes or when mitigation completes.
```
olivia: suggested customer-facing note (short):

"We are investigating elevated error rates for LLM requests in the northamerica-west1 zone-b. Traffic has been shifted to alternate zones to reduce impact. Our engineers are working on a fix; ETA 45 minutes. We will post updates on the status page. For urgent issues, contact support@redwoodelaf.example"
maya: posting initial status page update now. pinging cs for priority customers.
incident-bot: Status page updated by maya: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/NA-WEST1-20260315-1
olivia: I've queued an escalation DM to top 10 enterprise customers in NA with a slightly more detailed note, and included recommended mitigations for customers that run pinned deployments in zone-b: advise them to failover to multi-zone routing if possible or hold retries for 30s.
kevin: quick note for runbook — if switch replacement doesn't fix fabric in 60m, prepare to evict pods from rack-11 and re-provision on rack-14. Command I will run if needed:

```
# cordon and drain affected nodes
kubectl cordon node rack-11-*-wnw
kubectl drain node rack-11-*-wnw --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
```
jess: handoff plan: maya will continue as primary oncall for next 45m, then hand off to kevin for remediation/resync once fabric replacement begins. We'll put a pinned note with next steps.
maya: ack. kevin — if you take over, please send the 'handoff summary' message with current mitigation, routing override IDs, and links to logs.
kevin: will do. current override id: ro-9832-naw1. Link to logs: https://logs.redwood.ai/q/ro-9832-naw1
incident-bot: Handoff reminder scheduled in 40 minutes to #oncall-handoffs.
olivia: CS: flagged three customers (acct-112, acct-309, acct-501) with pinned dashboards showing errors. I'll do 1:1 DMs on escalation channel.
maya: update 14:28Z — 5xx rate stable ~2.1%. latency slightly up for cold cache requests, but overall success rates recovered. Keeping override active and monitoring.
kevin: network team just confirmed fabric replacement started. ETA now 35m.
jess: please capture a short post-incident note for internal comms once we have resolution — include timeline, mitigation steps, customer impact, and follow-ups (e.g., improve cross-zone failover docs, add synthetic checks for zone-b racks).
olivia: drafted follow-up internal comms snippet:

"Summary: Partial degradation in northamerica-west1 zone-b caused by intermittent top-of-rack switch flapping. Traffic was shifted to alternate zones and the fabric replacement completed without data loss. Impact: ~18% 5xx at peak for 40 minutes; reduced to <3% after mitigation. Action items: add automatic per-rack failover, expand synthetic canaries to cover rack-level fabric, update runbooks."
maya: 15:02Z — network reports fabric healthy, draining override to allow 10% traffic back to zone-b for warmup.

```
redwood route update text-generate-prod --remove-override ro-9832-naw1 --drain=none --weight zone-b=10
```
incident-bot: Observability: 5xx rate back to baseline <0.5%. Latency within SLO. Marking status: monitoring. Will update final after 1hr of stable metrics.
kevin: I'm taking the remediation ownership now per handoff. Summary: override ro-9832-naw1 active, fabric replacement complete, monitoring for regression. next steps: verify health across rack-11, runcache warmup checks.
maya: handed off to kevin. thanks all.
olivia: final customer note to send when stable (short):

"Update: The serving degradation in northamerica-west1 (zone-b) has been mitigated. Traffic was temporarily shifted to alternate zones while hardware repairs completed. Most customers should see normal service; please reach out if you see persistent errors."
jess: filing postmortem ticket and tagging oncall runbook owners for follow-ups.
status-bot: Final status page update queued. Incident moved to 'Monitoring' at 2026-03-15T15:02:00Z.
